title: 2022 and 2023: Param Digger, the browser recorder, and Postman
description: Student Hall of Fame entries for 2022-2023 GSoC: Param Digger, Browser Recorder, and Postman Support
narrative:
For a small team, the students who build add-ons are easy to lose track of, so a named entry probably matters. The ZAP Student Hall of Fame lists all three. Arkaprabha Chakraborty is credited with Param Digger in 2022. Aryan Gupta is listed for Browser Recorder (2023), and Vitika Soni is listed for Postman Support (2023).

Param Digger began with a commit titled Add initial param miner extension, dated June 2022, and the add-on finds parameters that are not visible in the normal interface. A commit dated August 2022 changed the name from paramminer to paramdigger.

One Browser Recorder commit adds dialogs for new client statements and is dated July 2023. A commit titled Add Postman add-on is dated June 2023. Dating each project from its first commit probably gives a fairer picture than the Hall of Fame year alone, since the two can differ.

Each of the three projects has its own story in the atlas, which follows its later history.

chapters.title: Param Digger
chapters.text: Arkaprabha Chakraborty's Param Digger (2022) begins as "Add initial param miner extension" (2022-06-02), then "Add refactorings to change paramminer to paramdigger" (2022-08-21). The add-on finds parameters that are not visible in the normal interface.

chapters.title: Browser Recorder
chapters.text: Aryan Gupta is listed for Browser Recorder (2023). The commit "zest: add dialogs for new client statements (#4698)" is dated 2023-07-05. The page states ZAP was not selected as a GSoC mentoring organisation in 2024.

chapters.title: Postman Support
chapters.text: Vitika Soni is listed for Postman Support (2023). The commit "Add Postman add-on" is dated 2023-06-03.
